response.overview: The 2026 Crown Jewel, also promoted as Crown Jewel: Riyadh (Arabic: جوهرة التاج: الرياض, romanized: jawharat altaaji: alriyad), is an upcoming professional wrestling pay-per-view (PPV) and livestreaming event produced by the American company WWE, to be held for wrestlers from the promotion's main roster brands, Raw and SmackDown. It will be the eighth Crown Jewel and will take place on Saturday, November 7, 2026, at an unannounced venue in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia, as part of Riyadh Season. This will be the 16th event that WWE will hold in Saudi Arabia under a 10-year partnership in support of Saudi Vision 2030. The event will center around the men's and women's Crown Jewel Championship matches, which will feature the respective men's and women's world champions of Raw and SmackDown against each other to determine the better champion.
response.title: WWE Crown Jewel 2026
